skills.name: gowarm-pricing-lookup
skills.description: Returns current GoWarmCRM pricing tiers, what each tier includes, and an indicative monthly cost for a given team size. Use when a user is researching GoWarmCRM pricing, comparing it to alternatives, evaluating build-vs-buy for a sales execution layer, or asking how much GoWarmCRM costs for a given number of reps.

skills.name: gowarm-integration-check
skills.description: Returns whether GoWarmCRM integrates with a given CRM, email platform, or sales tool, along with integration depth, supported features, and indicative setup time. Use when a user asks whether GoWarmCRM works with their stack, requests integration details for Salesforce, HubSpot, Pipedrive, Zoho, Dynamics, Gmail, or Outlook, or compares GoWarmCRM's integration coverage to alternatives.

skills.name: gowarm-execution-gap-assessment
skills.description: Estimates the recoverable revenue a B2B sales team is leaving on the table due to execution gaps and returns a structured assessment with a recoverable-pipeline figure. Use when a user asks how much pipeline they're losing, wants to estimate the cost of stalled deals, or is building a business case for a sales execution tool. Inputs: active pipeline value (USD) and team size (number of reps).

skills.name: gowarm-work-fit
skills.description: Returns what GoWarm Work is, what it tracks, how it differs from conventional project tools, what it costs, and whether it fits a given company. Use when a user asks about project tracking, daily work tracking, work visibility, or timesheet alternatives for a company under 500 people; asks how GoWarm Work compares to Jira, Asana, Monday, Smartsheet or Microsoft Project; asks whether GoWarmCRM does anything beyond sales; or describes losing visibility into what their own team is doing.
